headings.usage: H1, H2, H3. MUST use tracking-tight for H1/H2.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-none text-[#2A2A2A] md:text-white
scale.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-none text-[#2A2A2A]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for breathing room. High negative space.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A: The 'Tetris' Grid for Gallery and About). Asymmetry is preferred.

buttons.primary: bg-[#A94438] text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-[#8C362A] transition-colors duration-300 font-medium
buttons.secondary: border border-[#A94438] text-[#A94438] px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-[#A94438] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 font-medium

cards.style: Go cardless. Use flat rectangular layouts, 1px subtle borders (border-[#EAE3D9]) if necessary, no heavy drop shadows. Prefer solid earthy backgrounds over glassmorphism for content areas.

navigation.style: Solid background bg-[#F8F5F0] with subtle border-b border-[#EAE3D9]. Must not be transparent over hero. Links: text-[#2A2A2A] hover:text-[#A94438].

marquee.style: The 'Editorial Ribbon' for Testimonials. bg-[#EAE3D9] text-[#2A2A2A] font-serif text-2xl py-8 gap-32.

hero.alt: Steaming bowl of Thukpa and Momos
hero.usage: Full width hero background with bg-black/50 overlay. Text left-aligned.

texture.usage: Subtle repeating background texture for sections like 'What Makes Us Special' or 'Menu Highlights'. mix-blend-multiply opacity-50.

header.description: Navigation bar featuring 'MAVEN KITCHEN' and Kannada subtitle 'ಮೇವನ್ ಕಿಚನ್'. Nav links left-aligned or space-between. Solid background.

hero.description: Bold headline 'Flavors of the Northeast, Right Here in Bengaluru'. Badges for 4.6★. CTAs: 'Order Now' and 'View Menu'. Full background image (hero_food) with gradient/overlay to ensure text contrast.

about.description: Asymmetrical layout. Large text block explaining the authentic flavors from Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram. Overlapping image of restaurant_interior.

menu_highlights.description: 5 categories: Momos, Thukpa & Soups, Starters, Main Course, Beverages. INR pricing. Text-heavy, elegant layout. Use flex row with dotted borders between item name and price for a classic menu feel.

features.description: What Makes Us Special. 3-4 blocks using Phosphor icons. Clean, cardless approach. Generous padding.

gallery.description: Bento Grid Mode A ('Tetris' layout). 6 images spanning different columns and rows to create an organic, artistic collage.

testimonials.description: Use react-fast-marquee. 'Editorial Ribbon' style with large serif font and wide gaps between reviews.

contact.description: Footer area. Phone (clickable), Address with Google Maps link, Hours. Zomato and Swiggy placeholders using the provided logo URLs.

technical_requirements.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., data-testid='hero-order-button').
technical_requirements.accessibility: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text over images using text-shadow or overlays. Include focus states for buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use custom HTML/Tailwind over Shadcn components for marketing layouts to ensure creative freedom.
Do not center-align the main hero text; left-align it for tension and narrative flow.
Use pure CSS dots or flexbox space-between for the menu pricing layout.
Use the exact media URLs provided in this file. NEVER use placeholder image services.
Create the specific design blocks (like the Tetris Gallery) manually using Tailwind Grid utilities (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12).
